name: Point Defiance Zoo & Aquarium
tagline: Starter zoo-side list: Sumatran tiger, Asian small-clawed otter, then ring-tailed lemurs — no aquarium cards.

practical.ticket_note: Point Defiance Park; parking can fill on sunny weekends.
practical.best_start: Aquarium/ocean indoor if raining; outdoor Asia/NW loop if clear.

items.label: Sumatran tiger
items.one_liner: Asian Forest Sumatran tiger (Bintang) — orange stripes in the trees.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Sumatran tiger?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.label: Asian small-clawed otter
items.one_liner: Asian Forest otters — smallest otter, biggest splash.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Asian small-clawed otter?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.label: Ring-tailed lemur
items.one_liner: Kids' Zone ring-tailed lemurs — striped tail and a long stare.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Ring-tailed lemur?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.presence_note: Official story names ring-tailed lemurs Bobbi and Freedom; Kids' Zone also has ruffed lemurs.

research_notes: [2026-08-23] Wave 2b: zoo-side habitat pages only. Aquarium shark/jelly/turtle/ray dropped. Short published-card list. No invented verify date.

do_not_list.name: African penguin
do_not_list.reason: Official Penguin Point: Magellanic penguins, not African.

do_not_list.name: African elephant
do_not_list.reason: Former elephant barn is being converted; historical elephant was Asian.

do_not_list.name: Reticulated giraffe
do_not_list.reason: Not on official habitat animal lists.

do_not_list.name: Zebra
do_not_list.reason: Not on official habitat animal lists.

do_not_list.name: Shark
do_not_list.reason: Sharks are Pacific Seas / Tropical Reef aquarium habitats — not a zoo-side card.

do_not_list.name: Red panda
do_not_list.reason: Not on the official Asian Forest animal list.

bonus_hunt.tagline: Point Defiance bonus · Asian Forest + Kids' Zone (zoo-side)

challenges.text: Sumatran tiger: count stripe clusters on one shoulder.
Asian small-clawed otter: find the splashiest 10 seconds.
Ring-tailed lemur: striped tail up or a long sit?
Point to Asian Forest on a map, then Kids' Zone.
